headline: Sectra Reports Increased Sales and Profitability in First Half
summary: Medical imaging IT and cybersecurity company Sectra reported increased sales and profitability for the first half of the year, driven by strong performance in the North American market.
why: Sectra is an international medical IT and cybersecurity firm whose financial results reflect demand in healthcare technology sectors.
